title: Skin Center
description: skincenter.com Skin Center dermatology clinic in Fort Lauderdale, FL (6550 N Federal Hwy, Suite 320) with 40+ years of practice roots (formerly Dr. Roger Stewart's clinic, led by Dr. Barry Galitzer since the 2010s). Full spectrum: medical dermatology, Mohs surgery for skin cancer, cosmetic injectables/lasers (Botox, CoolSculpting, Ultherapy, Fraxel), an Acne Center, aesthetics, and massage. The hidden headline: since 2021 it's owned by Forefront Dermatology (125+ clinics, backed by Canadian pension fund OMERS Private Equity) — billing, records, and HR run through the network, not the local brand. Doctors rate excellent (Galitzer 4.7/5 on Healthgrades; Castle Connolly Top Doctor), but admin/office process is the weak spot — complaints cite long waits, forgotten patients, and a brusque bedside manner. Team: ~10 providers (Galitzer, Fien, Perrotto, Soro, White, Brown + PAs), plus a second office in Pompano Beach; 200+ patients/day, 10,000 sq ft.
